Boxwood hedges get trimmed **twice a year** — once in **late spring** after the first flush, once in **late summer**. Use the cordless trimmer (charge the battery the night before; it does not hold charge in storage). Blade oil after every session.

**How to apply:** put the two trims on the calendar. Do not trim in a heat wave — the cut faces scorch. Related: [[old-mower-brand]], [[compost-bin-setup]].
